title: Google Ads for Photographers | Photography to Profits

facts.fact: The page's booking economics calculator uses a default monthly ad budget of $1,000.
facts.quote: Monthly Ad Budget $1,000

facts.fact: The booking economics calculator uses a default cost per lead of $25.
facts.quote: Cost Per Lead $25

facts.fact: The booking economics calculator uses a default lead-to-booking rate of 25%.
facts.quote: Lead → Booking Rate 25%

facts.fact: The booking economics calculator uses a default average booking value of $2,500.
facts.quote: Average Booking Value $2,500

facts.fact: Photography to Profits states it has audited hundreds of ad accounts and found the same four problems every time.
facts.quote: We've audited hundreds of ad accounts and see the same four problems every time.

facts.fact: Photography to Profits' example says it turns a $4 click into a $3,000 booking.
facts.quote: We know the exact structure required to turn a $4 click into a $3,000 booking.

facts.fact: A testimonial from a wedding photographer says they spent over $3,000 on Google Ads over two years with nothing to show, and after rebuilding with P2P their cost per booking was under $200 within 60 days.
facts.quote: I'd spent over $3,000 on Google Ads over two years and had nothing to show for it. Within 60 days of rebuilding everything with P2P, my cost per booking was under $200

facts.fact: Photography to Profits offers a 120-day guarantee that refunds management fees if the client does not recover those fees within 120 days, and it does not cover ad spend or other costs.
facts.quote: If you follow our system and do not recover your management fees within 120 days, we refund those management fees. The guarantee does not cover ad spend or other costs.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Ads in 2026 uses AI Max to expand search matching, customize ad text, and select landing pages.
facts.quote: Google Ads in 2026 uses AI Max to expand search matching, customize ad text, and select landing pages.

facts.fact: Photography to Profits says it performs weekly optimization reviews of client Google Ads campaigns.
facts.quote: Weekly optimization reviews, no set-it-and-forget-it ever

facts.fact: Photography to Profits states there is no fixed price for Google Ads clicks, since each click is priced in an auction that depends on competing bidders, search specificity, and ad and landing page relevance.
facts.quote: There is no fixed price. Every click is priced in that auction, so what you pay depends on how many studios bid in your market

facts.fact: Photography to Profits describes Google Ad Rank as a combination of bid, ad quality, and landing page relevance.
facts.quote: Your bid, your ad quality and your landing page relevance combine into your Ad Rank

facts.fact: Google's average daily budget documentation caps a month's spend at 30.4 times the average daily budget for most campaigns, per the vendor's citation of Google's documentation.
facts.unit: times average daily budget per month
facts.quote: caps a month's spend at 30.4 times your average daily budget for most campaigns

facts.fact: Google's documentation lets a single busy day spend up to twice the average daily budget.
facts.unit: times average daily budget per day
facts.quote: lets a single busy day spend up to twice it.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends setting the daily budget to the monthly budget divided by 30.4.
facts.quote: Set your daily budget to your monthly budget divided by 30.4.

facts.fact: Google names conversion volume as one of three factors that determine how long a bid strategy stays in its learning period.
facts.quote: Google names conversion volume as one of the three factors that decide how long a bid strategy stays in its learning period

facts.fact: The vendor recommends targeting people within the studio's city plus a 15–25 mile radius of the service area.
facts.quote: Target people physically in your service area: your city plus a 15–25 mile radius.

facts.fact: Google's sitelink text is limited to 25 characters, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Each fits Google's 25-character limit, and none points at your homepage.

facts.fact: The vendor recommends testing at least two ad variations per ad group.
facts.quote: test at least two ad variations per ad group

facts.fact: Asset extensions (formerly ad extensions) are attached at no extra cost; the advertiser pays the same per click.
facts.quote: attached to your ad at no extra cost. You pay the same per click

facts.fact: The vendor lists four situations in which Search is the wrong first move for photographers.
